Told to become Jews or Christians, believers answer that they follow Abraham's religion and believe in all the prophets were given without distinction, for Allah's religion is best.
Believers are told to enter Islam completely and not follow Satan, are warned against deviating after clear proofs, and are reminded that all matters return to Allah.
There is no compulsion in religion; whoever rejects Taghut and believes in Allah holds the firmest handhold, as Allah brings believers into light and Taghut takes disbelievers into darkness.
All in the heavens and earth submit to Allah, believers believe in what all the prophets were given, and no religion other than Islam will be accepted.
Believers are told to believe in Allah, His Messenger, His Book and earlier Scripture; whoever disbelieves in Allah, His angels, books, messengers and the Last Day has strayed far.
Mankind is told the Messenger has brought the truth from their Lord, so believing is better; if they disbelieve, everything in the heavens and earth belongs to Allah.
The Prophet declares his religion is the straight way of Abraham, his prayer, sacrifice, life and death are for Allah alone, and each soul bears only its own burden.
Had the Lord willed, all on earth would have believed; the Prophet is asked whether he would compel people to believe, and no soul believes except by Allah's permission.
Your religion is one religion and Allah is your Lord, so worship Him; yet they divided their affair among themselves, and all will return to Him.
Believers are told to bow, prostrate, worship, do good and strive for Allah in Abraham's religion, without hardship, named Muslims, establishing prayer, giving zakah and holding to Allah.
Turn to the true religion, the fitrah Allah created people upon, turning to Him in repentance, fearing Him, establishing prayer, and not associating others with Him or splitting into sects.
Allah ordained the religion He enjoined on Noah, Abraham, Moses and Jesus, to establish it undivided; people divided out of jealousy; the Prophet must invite to it and stay upright.
The Messenger of Allah is among them; Allah has made faith beloved and disbelief hateful to them, as bounty and favor from Him.
Bedouins who say they believe are told to say they submitted, as faith has not entered their hearts; believers do not doubt but strive; guidance to faith is Allah's favor.
None is more unjust than one who lies about Allah; disbelievers want to extinguish Allah's light, but He perfects it, sending His Messenger with the religion of truth.
The Prophet tells the disbelievers he will not worship what they worship nor they what he worships; they have their religion and he has his.
